mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_order (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, goods_id, amount, trade_type, exchange_goods_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{goodsId}, #{amount}, #{tradeType}, #{exchangeGoodsId}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, g.title as goodsTitle, g.images as goodsImage, g.status as goodsStatus, eg.title as exchangeGoodsTitle, eg.images as exchangeGoodsImage, eg.status as exchangeGoodsStatus, b.nickname as buyerName, s.nickname as sellerName FROM goods_order o LEFT JOIN goods_info g ON o.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN goods_info eg ON o.exchange_goods_id = eg.goods_id LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON o.buyer_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user s ON o.seller_id = s.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods_order WHERE create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods_order WHERE status = 2
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM goods_order WHERE status = 2 AND create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM goods_order WHERE trade_type = 0 AND status = 2
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM goods_order WHERE trade_type = 0 AND status = 2 AND create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_type = 0 AND status = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gmv FROM goods_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE goods_order SET status = #{status} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE goods_order SET status = #{newStatus} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goods_order WHERE trade_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1) AND (goods_id = #{goodsId} OR exchange_goods_id = #{goodsId})
SELECT * FROM goods_order WHERE trade_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1) AND order_id != #{excludeOrderId} AND (goods_id = #{goodsId} OR exchange_goods_id = #{goodsId})
mapper.update: UPDATE goods_order SET status = 3 WHERE trade_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1) AND (goods_id = #{goodsId} OR exchange_goods_id = #{goodsId})
UPDATE goods_order SET status = 3 WHERE trade_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1) AND order_id != #{excludeOrderId} AND (goods_id = #{goodsId} OR exchange_goods_id = #{goodsId})
